responsibility: Provides the base GCC target configuration shared by DragonFly BSD targets. It defines DragonFly preprocessor builtins and assertions, startup/endfile/lib/link specs for executable and shared linking, the default dynamic linker path, ELF object-format settings, standard wchar/wint definitions, and common OS facilities such as POSIX I/O support. This file is the main OS configuration header for DragonFly, while dragonfly.opt only declares driver option names and dragonfly-d.cc only serves the D frontend.
same_name_distinction: Within the DragonFly same-name pair, this header defines the actual OS target configuration macros and linker/spec behavior; dragonfly.opt is only the companion option table that makes DragonFly-specific driver spellings recognizable.
